'''Somaled New''' was a [[human]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> who attended the celebrations held at the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> after the [[Resistance]] and its [[Citizens' Fleet|allies]] from around [[the galaxy]] [[Battle of Exegol|defeated]] the [[First Order]] and [[Sith Eternal]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]<ref name="TROS" /> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> During the celebration, New sat by the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Klaud]] when the [[Trodatome]] received a hug from [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]]. New wore a [[Color|blue]] [[flight suit]] with a spherical [[helmet]], which they kept on during the celebration.<ref name="TROS" /> New had tan skin and brown [[eye]]s and [[hair]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Somaled New first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was simultaneously identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
